summary: Iteration 4: Verified new Individual Hat Product Page template at /shop/:slug. Backend: 16/16 pytest pass (products list w/ 6 hats + CAD prices [the-renegade 249, midnight-renegade 249, renegade-red 275, the-outlaw 275, the-wanderer 295, the-shaman 325], no _id leakage, GET /api/products/{slug} 200/404, custom-requests endpoint 404, contact & newsletter, Stripe checkout (checkout.stripe.com cs_test_...) + 409 sold, admin passcode auth, PATCH sold toggle + reset). Frontend desktop 1536: for all 6 slugs product-name/product-ooak-badge ('One of a Kind')/product-price ($249/$275/$325/$275/$295/$249 CAD)/product-availability ('Available · Only one')/product-description/product-story-text/product-detail-{hat-size,material,colour,hatband,details,handmade}/product-back-link/product-back-link-bottom/product-related all render; related excludes current hat (relatedSelf=false) and shows 4 others. Related card click navigates to new product page and content updates (the-renegade -> renegade-red confirmed). product-add-to-cart 'Claim This Renegade' adds to cart: cart-drawer opens, nav-cart-count 0->1, button changes to 'Claimed — In Your Cart'; clicking again reopens drawer; cart-checkout-button redirects to checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_... (The Wanderer CA$295.00 shown). Sold flow via PATCH /api/admin/products/the-shaman with X-Admin-Passcode=renegade2026 -> product-sold-stamp visible, availability 'Sold — gone for good', button disabled with text 'Sold'; related on other pages now excludes the-shaman (4 cards: renegade-red, the-outlaw, the-wanderer, midnight-renegade). Mobile 390: product-dot-0..2 render, dot click switches image, no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=clientWidth=390). Desktop thumbnails product-thumb-0 visible. Nav desktop (1536): header shows exactly Home/Shop/About/Gallery/Contact/FAQ (footer additionally has Shop/About/Contact/Shipping & Returns/FAQs/Privacy as expected). Mobile menu via nav-mobile-toggle shows exactly ['Home','Shop','About','Gallery','Contact','FAQ']. Unknown slug /shop/unknown-hat shows product-not-found. All sold flags reset to false; verified via GET /api/products.
critical_code_review_comments: Product.js Related component uses useProducts() hook which may make a separate list call; acceptable but if products context is already loaded upstream it could be reused. Low priority.

Gallery dots are hidden only on lg: breakpoint — on tablet (sm/md 768-1024) both dots AND thumbnails CSS classes conflict (dots hidden lg:hidden but thumbs hidden lg:grid). Tablet shows dots only, which is fine but doc behavior: desktop=thumbs, mobile=dots is still met.
stripe.Price.list(lookup_keys=[...]) is called sequentially per slug per checkout — minor rate-limit risk for larger carts (unchanged from prior iterations).
seed_data_creation: Reused prior TEST_ newsletter and contact entries from pytest run. the-shaman and the-outlaw sold flags toggled during tests, both reset to sold=false (verified via GET /api/products).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Product page testids: product-page, product-gallery, product-main-image, product-ooak-badge, product-sold-stamp, product-dot-{i}, product-thumb-{i}, product-number, product-name, product-subtitle, product-price, product-availability, product-description, product-add-to-cart, product-shipping-link, product-story, product-story-text, product-details, product-detail-{hat-size|material|colour|hatband|details|handmade}, product-related, product-back-link, product-back-link-bottom, product-not-found, product-loading. Related cards reuse FeaturedCard with testid featured-card-{slug}. Cart drawer: cart-drawer, cart-checkout-button, nav-cart-count. All 6 sold flags verified false post-run.
